routing:
Plain text description of routes:
- Public: / (Home), /collections/unstitched (Unstitched Fabrics), /collections/ready-to-wear (Pret), /collections/men-and-kids (Men & Kids), /collections/home-and-fragrances (Home & Fragrances), /sale (Seasonal Sale), /track-order (Track Order), /login, /signup, /product/:id (Product Detail with 3D)
- User Area (requires Customer guard): /account/dashboard, /account/orders, /account/wishlist, /account/rewards
- Admin Area (requires Admin/Manager guard): /admin/dashboard, /admin/products, /admin/orders, /admin/inventory, /admin/discounts
notes: Store API includes: getProducts, addProduct, updateProduct, deleteProduct, getOrders, updateOrderStatus, getWishlist, toggleWishlist, getCart, addToCart, removeFromCart, updateCartQuantity, clearCart, getDiscounts, addDiscount, updateDiscount, deleteDiscount, addLoyaltyPoints, trackOrder, login, signup, logout. Props convention: standard React components with destructured props, explicit fallback values, and Tailwind CSS utility classes.

files.purpose: StoreProvider + useStore(): auth with roles (demo admin + demo user), CRUD + actions for every entity in the spec, cart/bookings/etc. as needed, toast notify, all persisted in localStorage
seed data for every entity in the spec (realistic, 8-15 items where lists make sense) + helpers like formatters
files.exports: named: seed arrays + helper functions (see file)

files.purpose: default export useDevice() -> { isMobile, isTablet, reduceMotion, canUse3D } (canUse3D = WebGL available && !isMobile && !reduceMotion)
HTML shell: <div id="root">, module script /src/main.jsx, Google Font <link> tags from the design system, title + meta, theme-color
createRoot, BrowserRouter, StoreProvider, imports index.css and App
@import "tailwindcss"; @theme tokens from the design system, base styles, grain/texture utilities, scrollbar, selection, reduced-motion rules

shared UI kit as named exports: Button, Card, Badge, Input, Select, Textarea, Modal, Reveal (scroll reveal), SectionTitle, Stat, EmptyState, Toaster, Table helpers - in the design system's signature style
files.exports: named: Button, Card, Badge, Input, Select, Textarea, Modal, Reveal, SectionTitle, Stat, EmptyState, Toaster

files.purpose: named exports IntroLoader (branded first-load preloader: animated brand mark + progress counter, ~1.8s, plays once per session, then reveals the site) and RouteLoader (small branded fallback for Suspense)
default export ProtectedRoute({role, children}) redirecting to /login, wrong role -> /
default export ErrorBoundary (class component) that shows the error message + stack on screen in a styled box with a reload button, so a crash is never a silent blank page

all routes from the MANIFEST routing plan, every page lazy-loaded with Suspense + RouteLoader, IntroLoader on first visit, Toaster, guards for user/admin areas; the whole route tree is wrapped in ErrorBoundary

default export Scene3D({variant, className, ...}) wrapper: if !canUse3D render Fallback3D, else lazy-load the heavy scene; Canvas dpr={[1,1.5]}, pause (frameloop never) when off screen via IntersectionObserver
default export Fallback3D({variant,...}) lightweight CSS-3D (perspective + rotateX/Y on pointer/gyro-free gentle keyframes) themed to the project; used on phones
